primary_intent: Comment organiser un voyage à moto dans le delta du Mékong (régions, routes, bacs, saison) depuis Saigon.

evidence.FACTS: Removed unconfirmed rental claims (« agences sérieuses… casque, contrat écrit et contact d’assistance », « garages… prix doux ») and the unsourced ‘110–125 cm³ suffit’. Kept only hub-verified facts: Cần Thơ ≈170 km from HCMC (VnExpress), expressways closed to motorcycles (law 36/2024/QH15 art. 25, Lao Động), Mỹ Thuận–Cần Thơ expressway and Mỹ Thuận 2 bridge opened 24/12/2023 (Tạp chí Công Thương), Cần Thơ bridge ended ferry waits (Người Quan Sát), rainy season after 5 May to ~November (Pháp Luật TP.HCM), Kiên Giang merged into An Giang in 2025 (Sài Gòn Giải Phóng). Hanoi-rental paragraph aligned with hub: no confirmation a moto rented at Long Biên can leave the North; ask in writing. No price quoted. Licence sentence is generic (nationality/licence/cylindrée), no blanket claim. Ferries: ‘prennent couramment des deux-roues’ with hours/fare to check on site; no ferry fee or schedule stated.
evidence.INTENT: Main question: how to organise a moto trip in the Mekong Delta. OWNER of ‘le delta du Mékong à moto’. Differs from closest pages (nord-vietnam/ninh-binh-voyage-moto 0.42, bac-kan 0.33) because it is the only regional delta overview; sub-itineraries are delegated to saigon-my-tho-ben-tre, ho-chi-minh-a-can-tho, chau-doc.
evidence.CONTENT: Fully rewritten: removed mannered/lyrical passages (‘l’enfant saluent… le temps est le vrai luxe’, ‘bonheur’), SEO-process wording (‘guide d’ensemble sert de porte d’entrée’) and repetition. New: zones table, bridges/ferries/expressway section, 5-day circuit table, season table, rental/departure paragraph, practical checklist. Words 1895→1899.
evidence.META: Title, description, H1 and eyebrow rewritten; og:title/og:description identical to title/description. Title 56 chars, description 158 chars.
evidence.LINKS: Kept /centre-sud-vietnam/, /types-motos/, /permis-securite/securite/ (required) ; replaced hanoi-a-ho-chi-minh-moto, moto-ho-chi-minh-ville and vietnam-nord-a-sud with delta-specific siblings: saigon-my-tho-ben-tre-itineraire-moto, ho-chi-minh-a-can-tho-moto, chau-doc-voyage-moto. 6/7 unique internal links; parent hub present.
evidence.AEO_GEO: Lead answers the H1 question directly (3–5 days loop from Saigon, key zones, expressway ban, rainy season). 3 tables, 1 checklist, FAQ with 5 short non-repeating questions. Inline citations to hub-verified sources.
